\section[\texorpdfstring{\hi{सबक़} (sabaq)}{सबक़ (sabaq)}]{\hi{सबक़} (sabaq) — a lesson (learned)}

\label{lesson:HI-C554-sabaq}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Hindi for a stage, a phase, then the Hindi for a date (formal).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \hi{सबक़}}
\textbf{\hi{सबक़}} — \emph{sabaq} — \textquotedblleft{}a lesson (learned)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\hi{अपनी} \hi{ग़लती} \hi{से} \hi{मैंने} \hi{एक} \hi{बड़ा} \hi{सबक़} \hi{सीखा।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Apnī ġaltī se maiṁne ek baṛā sabaq sīkhā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I learned a big lesson from my mistake.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\hi{सबक़}} (\emph{sabaq}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{sabaq}, \textquotedblleft{}a lesson\textquotedblright{}, through Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\hi{अंततः} (antataḥ)}{अंततः (antataḥ)}]{\hi{अंततः} (antataḥ) — in the end, ultimately (formal)}

Before the new one: say the Hindi for a date (formal), then the Hindi for a lesson (learned).
